json.error: The mail queue could not be read because Postfix refuses its own configuration: a setting in /etc/postfix/main.cf or master.cf has an error, and Postfix's programs stop on it. What Postfix said about it is shown with this message. Nothing was changed, and this does not mean the queue is empty. The server owner corrects that setting, runs sudo postfix check until it prints no error, then reloads this page.
